This 2014 Dodge Durango Limited combines practicality, comfort, and capability in a versatile three-row SUV designed for families and those who value space and dependability.

- Leather trimmed bucket seats with heated front and rear seating
- Premium Group including power sunroof, navigation, and power liftgate
- Uconnect 8.4AN touchscreen with AM/FM, SiriusXM, HD Radio, and Bluetooth connectivity
- 9 amplified speakers with subwoofer and 506-watt amplifier
- 20-inch fully polished aluminum wheels with all-season tires
- AWD with 3.6L V6 flex fuel engine and 8-speed automatic transmission
- Remote vehicle start and keyless entry system
- Back up sensors with rear parking camera
- Towing package for hauling capability
- Memory seat and power driver positioning
- Automatic temperature control with front and rear dual-zone air conditioning

The Durango Limited provides three rows of seating flexibility with split-folding rear seats, making it adaptable to various cargo and passenger configurations. The split-bench third row accommodates additional passengers when needed, while the power liftgate simplifies loading and unloading. With back up sensors and a rear parking camera, maneuvering this substantial vehicle becomes more intuitive and safer around obstacles and pedestrians.

Inside, the cabin reflects the Limited trim's refined approach to comfort. Heated leather seats warm occupants during colder months, and the dual-zone automatic climate control ensures individual temperature preferences are maintained throughout the cabin. The Uconnect 8.4AN infotainment system integrates navigation, smartphone connectivity via Bluetooth, and SiriusXM satellite radio to keep you informed and entertained on every drive.

Whether commuting through Tampa Bay or heading out on a Florida Gulf Coast road trip, this Flex delivers capability and versatility in equal measure.

The 2017 Accord belongs to Honda's ninth-generation Accord family and uses a 2.4-liter direct-injected four-cylinder engine paired with a continuously variable transmission. Honda rated the standard version of this engine at 185 horsepower, creating a powertrain focused on smooth response and everyday efficiency rather than unnecessary complexity.

That personality suits the Accord exceptionally well.

Around San Antonio, it is manageable and composed in everyday traffic. Out on Interstate 10, the Accord settles naturally into highway driving, with the kind of ride and road manners that make longer trips considerably easier. Premium value isn't always about buying the newest vehicle available. Sometimes it comes from choosing a well-established model in a desirable trim and allowing the original owner to absorb much of the initial depreciation.

The 2016 Buick Enclave Premium Group immediately stands out for its advanced technology ecosystem, featuring a large Color Touch infotainment system with integrated navigation and IntelliLink, delivering a clear, responsive interface for both entertainment and connectivity.

Buyers who prioritize staying connected and leveraging in-car technology will find this SUV especially appealing. The Enclave's suite of features, including voice-activated navigation, steering wheel-mounted audio controls, and remote keyless entry, enables effortless use of mobile apps and instant access to information. For tech-forward drivers in St. Louis facing busy commutes or frequent family trips, the combination of IntelliLink, OnStar Guidance, and rear audio controls means everyone can stay engaged and productive on the road without missing a beat. Seven-passenger seating and a power liftgate add convenience for those who depend on their vehicle as a mobile office or family command center.

Driving the Enclave feels refined and technologically enhanced, thanks to its 3.6L V6 SIDI VVT engine paired with a 6-speed automatic electronic transmission with overdrive. The all-wheel drive system works in concert with electronic stability control to adapt traction and handling to changing road conditions, while digital throttle controls and an advanced suspension deliver a composed, comfortable ride. Electronic brake assist and a smart transmission ensure responsive acceleration and smooth gear changes, whether navigating city traffic or setting out on longer journeys. The SUV's available trailering package adds flexibility for tech-savvy families who need to haul gear or recreational equipment with confidence.

Smart safety is at the forefront of this vehicle's design, with sensors and cameras working continuously to monitor surroundings and enhance protection. The Enclave integrates an exterior parking camera, rear parking sensors, and a comprehensive airbag system, including dual front and side impact airbags, all coordinated by advanced electronic stability and traction control algorithms. High-intensity Bi-Xenon headlights automatically adapt to visibility needs, while blind spot monitoring via sensors helps prevent lane-change incidents. OnStar Guidance provides an extra layer of safety through real-time emergency response and roadside assistance, giving drivers peace of mind even on unfamiliar roads.

Feature-rich packages like the Premium Group, Enclave Tuscan Edition, and Experience Buick Package add tangible value to the Enclave. Perforated leather-appointed seats, heated and ventilated front seats, a heated steering wheel, memory settings, and tri-zone automatic climate control create a personalized, comfortable environment.

Compared to competitors like the Acura MDX and Ford Explorer, the Enclave distinguishes itself through a larger, more premium touchscreen interface and a superior Bose 10-speaker audio system.

Does this SUV have wireless CarPlay or Android Auto? While the Enclave's Color Touch system offers Bluetooth connectivity and voice-activated controls, it does not include wireless CarPlay or Android Auto; app streaming and hands-free functions are managed through IntelliLink and Bluetooth.

To experience the advanced technology and connectivity of the 2016 Buick Enclave Premium Group, contact Dave Sinclair Ford at or visit 7466 S Lindbergh Blvd, St. Louis, MO 63125. Discover how this SUV keeps you and your family seamlessly connected in today's digital world.
